Aurora

The six minutes in which the lagoon changes colour

There is a moment just before dawn when the water of the lagoon turns from grey to gold, and nobody notices because the city is still asleep. Aurora was born from those six minutes: soft shapes, a contained eye size, colours that seem lit from within. The most discreet frame in the collection, and the hardest to forget.
